professionalSummary.text: Accountable owner of the product event-tracking pipeline for customer-facing dashboards at Brindle Analytics from March 2020 to April 2024.
professionalSummary.witness: Data engineer at Brindle Analytics from March 2020 to April 2024, working on the product event-tracking pipeline behind the customer-facing dashboards, which ingests web, mobile and billing events. | the former vice president of data confirmed in writing that from 2022 the candidate was the named owner of the event-tracking pipeline, with approval rights over every schema change to the event tables.

experienceHighlights.text: Built and maintained dbt models for event tables with automated data tests (not-null, uniqueness, accepted-value) running on every pull request.
experienceHighlights.witness: Built and maintained the dbt models for the event tables, with not-null, uniqueness and accepted-value tests running on every pull request.

experienceHighlights.text: Ran data-quality incident rota for the pipeline, opening incidents for freshness failures and documenting follow-ups with cause, fix, and backfill needs.
experienceHighlights.witness: Ran the data-quality incident rota for the pipeline, opening an incident whenever a freshness check failed and writing the follow-up for each, with the cause, the fix and any backfill needed.

experienceHighlights.text: Agreed data contracts with three producer teams (web app, mobile, billing) defining event names, required fields, and a 30-day change-notice period, reviewed biannually.
experienceHighlights.witness: Agreed data contracts with three producer teams (web app, mobile and billing) setting out event names, required fields and a change-notice period, and reviewed each contract with its producer team every six months.

experienceHighlights.text: Reported pipeline's monthly warehouse spend to head of data and proposed table-partitioning changes, which were approved by head of data and implemented by candidate.
experienceHighlights.witness: Reported the pipeline's monthly warehouse spend to the head of data and proposed table-partitioning changes, which the head of data approved and the candidate then implemented.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Data contract with billing team including event schema, field definitions, 30-day change-notice clause, and signatures of both team leads.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: the data contract agreed with the billing team, with the event schema, field definitions, a 30-day change-notice clause and the signatures of both team leads.

skills.text: dbt modeling with automated data tests
skills.witness: Built and maintained the dbt models for the event tables, with not-null, uniqueness and accepted-value tests running on every pull request.

optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The materials establish the candidate's role as accountable owner of the pipeline (with approval rights), dbt model building with automated tests, incident rota management, data contract agreements, and budget reporting. The materials do not establish the candidate's direct management of the cloud data-warehouse budget (only reporting and proposing changes), nor the candidate's role as the sole accountable owner for the entire pipeline (only approval rights over schema changes).
